messages:
sofia: Shiproom asked for a defensible tenanted-staggered cutover plan for the upcoming EU private model swap. Need clear manual gate, per-tenant caps, and who owns each fallback. Short writeup pls.
raj: High-level: per-tenant cookie + staggered waves by customer tier. Start with 2% enterprise tenants, 5% standard, then widen. Keep per-tenant cap 40rps.
amina: Add a manual review gate after warmup before any >10% bump. Automation can suggest but product must approve.
ops-bot: note: any private rollout touching >5% tenants must have oncall pinned and a pre-approved rollback playbook attached.
sofia: I want explicit decay rules: if a tenant trips circuit twice in 20m, set exposure=0 and record reason. Auto-unfreeze only after manual review or 4h cooldown.
pete: Prefer a soft-degrade chain: quantized -> prompt-simplify -> token-limit -> full-kill. Infra to own quantized variants; product owns prompt templates.
ml-eval: For A/B hallucination probes: run a 1k-session A/B (50/50) from churn-sensitive tenants during warmup. Quick sanity after 20m, full scoring at 3h. Threshold: hallucination delta <= +1.1.
sec-bot: security checklist: signed manifest present, image signature verified, KMS checks green for 10m. If any fail, hold and notify #eng-oncall.
raj: Flag sketch:
```
flags.swap_wave.eu_private = {
  waves: [ {tier: "enterprise", frac: 0.02}, {tier: "standard", frac: 0.05}, {tier: "broad", frac: 0.20} ],
  per_tenant_cookie: "72h",
  per_tenant_cap_rps: 40,
  warmup_mins: 25,
  manual_gate_after: "warmup+20m",
  decay_policy: {trips:2, window_mins:20, cooldown_hr:4},
  fallback_chain: ["quantized-v2","prompt-simplify-v1","token-cap-128","global-kill"],
  ab_probe: {size:1000, quick_sanity:20, full_eval:180},
  telemetry_tags: ["tenant.opt_in","rollback_reason"],
  approvals_required: ["product","security"]
}
```
amina: Manual gate flow: product gets automated signal pack (p95, error delta, hallucination, token-failure) + short diff of sample outputs. Product then clicks approve in shiproom UI. Target manual decision < 15m.
sofia: Roll-forward: if metrics improve after bump and no tenant circuits, allow product to auto-greenlight next wave. Otherwise keep manual control.
ml-eval: We'll produce 12 seed prompts + customer probes. Also recommend a shadow-run capturing full outputs for 0.5% of sessions for offline comparison.
ops-bot: scheduled-task: kms-health-check at 1812342200. Fail -> hold + alert #eng-oncall.
sec-bot: deploy policy: /deploy canary must include signed-manifest S3 path and security approval.
pete: Action items:
- pete + infra: publish quantized variant and ensure perf bench (owner)
- ml-eval: prepare AB prompts + scoring harness (owner)
- ops: confirm per-tenant cap enforcement + KMS preflight (owner)
- product (sofia): draft manual gate checklist and shiproom one-pager (owner)
Timeline: KMS check 1812342200, warmup 25m, quick sanity at +20m, manual review window at +45m, full eval at +3h.
sofia: If no objections to waves (2%->5%->20%) and 2-trip decay, give a thumbs. :thumbsup:
raj: :thumbsup:
amina: :thumbsup:
ml-eval: :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Deploy-bot: /deploy canary --requires-approvals product,security
sofia: Closing thread; I'll move this into shiproom and tag approvers. Reopen if anything changes.
